item.title: When the Star Performer Becomes the Boss
item.description:
Background

Putting a star performer in charge of a team or department seems a promising choice. Someone who excels at doing the work can take the lead on tasks and step in afterward to help with those the members leave undone. This paper examines theoretically how a star performer who becomes the boss and continues to take on much of the work can nevertheless reduce team output.
